mapper.insert: insert into post_tags ( post_id, tag_id ) values ( #{postId}, #{tagId} )
mapper.select: select t.tag_id, t.tag_name from post_tags pt join tags t on pt.tag_id = t.tag_id where pt.post_id = #{postId} order by t.tag_id
mapper.delete: delete from post_tags where post_id = #{postId} and tag_id = #{tagId}
mapper.select: select pt.post_id from post_tags pt where pt.tag_id = ( select t.tag_id from tags t where t.tag_name = #{tagName} )
